objectives.title: Make the public website a trusted digital front door
objectives.description: Prospective learners can find accurate course information, prices, stories and application paths quickly and confidently.
key_results: Maintain monthly availability of priority public pages
Reconcile public course and price entries to the approved catalogue
Deliver valid application submissions to the authorised destination
Reduce unresolved critical or high website findings

objectives.title: Replace paper-first reception with a consistent, secure welcome
objectives.description: Visitors and applicants complete a guided check-in while staff retain accurate records without manual filing.
key_results: Complete all required visitor contact and course fields
Log follow-up outcomes within two working days

objectives.title: Deliver a safe, learner-friendly Virtual Campus pilot
objectives.description: An approved learner group can learn, submit evidence and join live classes with clear support and reliable progress records.
key_results: Complete one approved lecturer and learner cohort pilot
Back pilot learner progress events with verifiable evidence
Complete scheduled pilot classes without critical learner-blocking incidents
Provide captions and a documented low-bandwidth option for pilot lesson videos

objectives.title: Turn Smart Lecturer into governed learner support
objectives.description: Learners receive useful, consistent answers without the system inventing policies, fees or admissions decisions.
key_results: Trace every published answer to an approved source
Show a human-support route for uncertain or high-impact questions
Achieve a positive supervised learner review rating

objectives.title: Make daily work, intake and decisions visible
objectives.description: Managers can see what was done, what is verified, what is behind target and who owns the next action.
key_results: Submit expected staff reports by the agreed monthly deadline
Review submitted reports within two working days
Complete monthly target reviews for active intake officers
Close meeting actions by their due date
Dispatch Wingu rows with approved attendance and Wingu-presented projects

objectives.title: Protect institutional data and keep services recoverable
objectives.description: Security incidents are contained quickly, sensitive information is protected and the team can restore service.
key_results: Reduce critical or high security findings older than fourteen days
Keep production secrets outside Git and complete quarterly review
Complete recorded restore exercises for priority systems

objectives.title: Use the Toolkit brand and poster library consistently
objectives.description: Public, print and learning communications look like one institution and approved campaign work retains reusable editable sources.
key_results: Index approved campaign assets with purpose, status and source format
Pass the brand checklist for sampled public and print outputs
Include required web, print or social and editable-source handoff in campaign releases

objectives.title: Operate a calm, auditable delivery process
objectives.description: Changes reach users through repeatable checks, clear ownership and non-disruptive deployment procedures.
key_results: Record a demo result, backup reference and route check for production releases
Assign every open launch blocker an owner and monthly next action
Maintain an operator guide, rollback note and status page for production systems
